title: Active Surface-Potential Measurement Design for Physics-Informed Reconstruction of Buried Grounding Electrodes: Reproducibility Package
description: Frozen MATLAB implementations, deterministic DOE provenance, final held-out result tables, post-held-out measurement-noise stress-test summaries, and portable scripts supporting the manuscript 'Active Surface-Potential Measurement Design for Physics-Informed Reconstruction of Buried Grounding Electrodes'.
